engineering_area_conflict.title: Review {count} room assignment conflicts
engineering_area_conflict.description: Room decisions are pending for {count} devices. Open this repair to choose room-group targets and per-device overrides.

abort.conflict_changed: The conflict set changed. Reopen the current repair and review the updated devices.
abort.entry_unavailable: The configuration entry changed or is unavailable. Reopen the current repair after the integration has refreshed.
abort.invalid_repair: This repair does not match a current room-conflict set.
abort.repair_unavailable: The current conflict set could not be verified. Reopen the repair after the integration has refreshed.
abort.resolution_failed: Some decisions remain unresolved. Reopen the current repair and review all remaining groups. A pending or changed created area can require manual selection of an existing area. No global area is deleted or rolled back.

error.invalid_rows: Keep every original row exactly once and do not edit its key. Review the submitted values.
error.invalid_target: Choose a supported action and only its required target: an existing area, a new name, or no target for Keep Home Assistant.
error.area_name_collision: An area already has this normalized name. Select that existing area explicitly instead of creating or adopting it by name.

rooms.title: Choose room-group assignments
rooms.description: Each row groups devices by an exact room identity, not its name. Select an existing area, explicitly create a new area, or keep Home Assistant assignments. Leave unused target fields empty. Do not edit group keys. Nothing is written until the device step is submitted.

devices.title: Review individual device decisions
devices.description: For room-group members, apply the group choice or keep the current Home Assistant assignment. For devices without a room identity, only Keep Home Assistant or Clear area is valid. Do not edit device keys. Submitting applies these explicit decisions.

reload.name: Pyloxone Reload
reload.description: Reloads the Loxone integration by reconnecting to the Miniserver and refreshing all entities. This is useful after making configuration changes in Loxone Config or when connection issues occur. All current entity states will be re\-synchronized from the Miniserver.
